Detect **factual contradictions** across documents using the `ConsistencyEngine`.
Enter documents containing structured claims and see which ones contradict each other.

```{python}
#| label: setup
from reranker.embedder import Embedder
from reranker.strategies.consistency import ConsistencyEngine

engine = ConsistencyEngine(embedder=Embedder())
```

## 1. Load Sample Data

```{python}
#| label: load-sample-data
sample_docs_a = [
    "Model2Vec Potion-8M reports latency_ms as 2.",
    "HybridFusionReranker reports best_metric as NDCG@10.",
    "Frodo Baggins was born in the Shire.",
    "BM25Engine requires no embedding model for inference.",
    "The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, France.",
    "HybridFusionReranker latency is 0.06ms on synthetic test.",
    "Algorithm X has space complexity O(n log n).",
    "BinaryQuantizedReranker scores at 22866 queries per second.",
]

sample_docs_b = [
    "Model2Vec Potion-8M reports latency_ms as 7.",
    "HybridFusionReranker reports best_metric as MRR.",
    "Frodo Baggins was born in Gondor.",
    "BM25Engine requires a pre-computed token index on disk.",
    "The Eiffel Tower is located in London, England.",
    "HybridFusionReranker latency is 0.94ms on synthetic test.",
    "Algorithm X has space complexity O(2^n).",
    "BinaryQuantizedReranker scores at 932 queries per second.",
]

docs = sample_docs_a + sample_docs_b
print(f"Loaded {len(docs)} documents ({len(sample_docs_a)} pairs)")
```

```{python}
#| label: run-engine
#| cache: true
engine.sim_threshold = 0.95
engine.value_tolerance = 0.01

extracted_claims = engine.extract_claims(docs)
detected_contradictions = engine.check(extracted_claims)
```

## 2. Extracted Claims

```{python}
#| label: display-claims
for idx, (cs, doc_text) in enumerate(zip(extracted_claims, docs)):
    print(f"\n### Document {idx + 1}")
    print(f"> {doc_text[:150]}")
    if cs.claims:
        print("| Entity | Attribute | Value | Source |")
        print("|--------|-----------|-------|--------|")
        for claim in cs.claims:
            print(f"| {claim.entity} | {claim.attribute} | `{claim.value}` | {claim.source_doc_id} |")
    else:
        print("*No structured claims extracted.*")
```

## 3. Detected Contradictions

```{python}
#| label: display-contradictions
print(f"Found **{len(detected_contradictions)}** contradictions.\n")
for i, c in enumerate(detected_contradictions):
    print(f"### Contradiction {i + 1}")
    print(f"- **Claim A:** `{c.claim_a.entity}` → {c.claim_a.attribute} = `{c.claim_a.value}` (from {c.claim_a.source_doc_id})")
    print(f"- **Claim B:** `{c.claim_b.entity}` → {c.claim_b.attribute} = `{c.claim_b.value}` (from {c.claim_b.source_doc_id})")
    print(f"- **Reason:** {c.reason}\n")
if not detected_contradictions:
    print("*No contradictions detected.*")
```

## 4. Batch Evaluation on Hardcoded Test Cases

```{python}
#| label: batch-evaluation
test_cases = [
    ("A: potion-base-32M latency is 0.02ms.", "B: potion-base-32M latency is 0.67ms.", True),
    ("A: BM25 achieves NDCG@10 of 0.0861.", "B: BM25 achieves NDCG@10 of 0.2000.", True),
    ("A: model2vec uses Potion embeddings.", "B: Potion embeddings power model2vec.", False),
    ("A: HybridFusion trains with XGBoost.", "B: XGBoost is used by HybridFusion.", False),
    ("A: Python 3.12 was released in October 2023.", "B: Python 3.12 was released in April 2024.", True),
]
```

```{python}
#| label: run-evaluation
tp = fp = fn = tn = 0
for doc_a, doc_b, expected in test_cases:
    eval_claims = engine.extract_claims([doc_a, doc_b], ["doc_a", "doc_b"])
    detected = len(engine.check(eval_claims)) > 0
    if expected and detected:
        tp += 1
    elif expected and not detected:
        fn += 1
    elif not expected and detected:
        fp += 1
    else:
        tn += 1

total = tp + fp + fn + tn
recall = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0.0
precision = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0.0
f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) if (precision + recall) > 0 else 0.0

print("### Evaluation Results\n")
print("| Metric | Value |")
print("|--------|-------|")
print(f"| Total samples | {total} |")
print(f"| True Positives | {tp} |")
print(f"| False Positives | {fp} |")
print(f"| False Negatives | {fn} |")
print(f"| True Negatives | {tn} |")
print(f"| **Recall** | **{recall:.2%}** |")
print(f"| **Precision** | **{precision:.2%}** |")
print(f"| **F1** | **{f1:.2%}** |")
```
